column1: # UCSC Genome Browser region tracks for variant annotation (hg38)
# This manifest describes BED files used for region-based variant annotation.
#   category    - filter (flag problematic regions) or annotate (add functional context)
#                 UCSC database tables have `bin` as column 1 (skip it).
#   description - What this track is and why it's useful
#   2. Check the .sql schema file to identify column positions
#   3. Add a row below with the extraction rule
# For non-UCSC sources (ENCODE, GIAB, etc.), set url to the direct download link
# and extract to "none" if the file is already in BED format.

column5: Segmental duplications. Variants in segdups are prone to mismapping artifacts.
Simple/tandem repeats (TRF). Indel calling errors enriched here. Cols: chrom,start,end,name.
RepeatMasker. All interspersed repeats (LINE, SINE, LTR, DNA, etc). Cols: chrom,start,end,swScore,strand,repName,repClass,repFamily.
Low-complexity regions (SDust). Catches LCRs that simpleRepeat/RepeatMasker miss; false positives cluster here.
Assembly gaps: centromeres, telomeres, heterochromatin, scaffold gaps. Cols: chrom,start,end,type. Variants near gaps are unreliable.
Microsatellite repeats (2-6bp units). Additional flag for indel calling errors from polymerase slippage.
Nested/interrupted repeats. Complex repeat structures where alignment is particularly difficult.
Self-chain alignments (paralogous regions). Extends beyond segDups to catch more distant paralogy. Cols: chrom,start,end.
ENCODE candidate cis-regulatory elements (926K). Classified: PLS (promoter), pELS/dELS (enhancer), CTCF, DNase-H3K4me3. Cols: chrom,start,end,name.
CpG islands. Mark promoter regions; variants here may affect gene regulation. Cols: chrom,start,end,name.
Conserved elements (100 vertebrates, phastCons). Noncoding variants in conserved elements are more likely functional. Cols: chrom,start,end,score.
NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog hits. Flag convergence between rare variants and common-variant GWAS signals. Cols: chrom,start,end,name(trait).
ENCODE unified blacklist (~910 regions). Anomalous signal in NGS experiments — variants here are almost certainly artifacts.
GIAB homopolymers: perfect >6bp + imperfect >10bp, 5bp slop. Indel/SNV calling errors from polymerase slippage in homopolymer runs.
GIAB non-unique mappability (100bp reads, 2 mismatches, 1 indel). Variants here may be mismapping artifacts from paralogous regions.
